tips_en: Read Paper 1 (ScienceIDE) first as it offers the broadest perspective, bridging benchmark construction and RL/SFT training for coding agents with strong empirical results. Papers 2 and 3 complement it nicely—Paper 2 extends the benchmark-construction paradigm (SWE-bench lineage) to reference-guided web app tasks, while Paper 3's sparse critic supervision could directly improve the PPO/GRPO training pipeline used in ScienceIDE. Together, the three form a coherent picture of the current frontier in environment design and RL methodology for code-reasoning agents.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文1（ScienceIDE），它覆盖面最广，将基准构建与编码智能体的RL/SFT训练结合，实证结果也非常扎实。论文2和论文3与它形成良好互补：论文2将基准构建范式（SWEBench谱系）拓展到参考引导的Web应用任务，论文3提出的稀疏Critic监督方法可直接改进ScienceIDE中使用的PPO/GRPO训练流程。三篇合在一起，完整勾勒出当前面向代码推理智能体的环境设计与强化学习方法的前沿图景。
